correctness.rationale: The incidence graph is simple with minimum degree at least two, each component uses at least four off-spine vertices and lies in one plane through the common spine, and the explicit four-point page construction attains the resulting bound.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The primary source gives only asymptotically matching complete-bipartite bounds, while targeted exact and equivalent-formulation searches found no prior K_{2,n} formula; residual risk from very recent or poorly indexed follow-up work is documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The result upgrades an explicitly noted complete-bipartite asymptotic case to an exact all-n formula with a structural incidence-page proof.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
